fights.description: One row per phase, not per boss: Rennala's bubble negates everything and her first phase takes extra physical, so a single row for 'Rennala' would be about a fight that does not exist.

fight.description: The phase's own name, as the table labels it.

location.description: Where it is fought. A name is not an identity: nine Death Rite Birds differ by location.

negation.description: Percentage negated, per requested type. Higher is worse for the attacker; negative means the fight takes extra.

best_type.description: The type this fight takes most, empty when two or more tie.

best_types.description: Every type tied for best. One entry means an outright winner.

takes_extra_from.description: Types with negative negation — the fight takes more than face value.

resist.description: Status buildup resisted. Zero here for an immunity, which `immune_to` carries instead.

immune_to.description: Statuses that cannot be applied at all. Immune is not 'tough': no buildup does anything.

best_against.description: Fights where this type is the outright best of those asked about.

tied_best_against.description: Fights where it ties for best. Counting a tie as a win inflates whichever type sorts first.

summary.description: Counted over every fight that passed the filters, not just the rows returned.

best_on_average.description: Lowest average negation across the fights asked about. A coverage answer: the winner on average can still be the worst pick for one fight, and the rows are there to check that.

phases.description: How many phases passed the filters. The summary is over all of them.
